war_summary: War 139 is on day 107 with conquest conditions active (32 towns required, none captured). The map is sharply divided: Colonials hold full or near-full control in many regions (AcrithiaHex, AllodsBightHex, AshFieldsHex, DeadLandsHex, FarranacCoastHex, etc.), while Wardens dominate others (BasinSionnachHex, ClansheadValleyHex, HowlCountyHex, ReachingTrailHex, ViperPitHex, etc.). The heaviest fighting and ownership volatility is concentrated in a few contested corridors—EndlessShoreHex, CallahansPassageHex, ClahstraHex, OarbreakerHex, GodcroftsHex, and OlavisWakeHex—where casualty and enlistment rates are accelerating and strategic bases are actively flipping or falling neutral. Quieter regions show stable ownership with minimal events, confirming that strategic-base ownership changes over the next 24 hours will likely be localized to these high-activity zones.
